items.title: Rufus Reid interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, GA, January 4, 2013
items.q: Slide Hampton — I got a chance to play with him

ctx.x: Well this could be a hard question, but how do you price your work?

That is difficult. Because like I say, I am a novice so I really feel I can’t do it. Because I’m slow. It takes me time. Although if they give me a timeline, that helps. Because now I say well this is a chunk of time in order for me to do this. I ask some friends, and I look © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

at — sometimes I look at some published charts and how much they are charging for the chart itself, and then I say well okay — and I may ask them what kind of budget that you have, and we can discuss it. Because I think it’s just like my performing. Everything’s on sliding scale as far as I’m concerned. And here again I realize they’re asking me now to write something and I would like to be paid as much money as I can possibly get paid.
